name: Regular Maintenance is Required
source:
Unit 1277-B is the latest model from a fantastic line of home cleaning robots. She is programmed to love and obey her master no matter what. Her master is very busy, and can't always complete the routine maintenance 1277-B needs to serve at maximum efficiency. How long will 1277-B last before her robot body falls apart?

[From [url=https://laddo-d.itch.io/regular-maintenance-is-required]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1277-B号机是某卓越家用清洁机器人产品线的最新型号。她的底层程序设定为无论发生什么都要深爱并服从主人。然而她的主人平日繁忙异常，无法总是按时完成1277-B号机维持最高运行效率所需的例行维护。在这具机械躯体彻底散架之前，1277-B号机还能坚持多久？

[摘自[url=https://laddo-d.itch.io/regular-maintenance-is-required]itch.io[/url]]
